notes.title: General improvements
notes.content:
- Improved game load speed
- Improved rendering performance

notes.title: Recenter options and several bugfixes
notes.content:
- Implemented recenter option on PauseScreen
- Added RecenterOnPlay option to Settings
- Added VR Headset Profile for Valve Index
- Fixed issue that the pause game action could get ignored
- Fixed issue that you can press play button while mission results were still loading
- Fixed visual glitch when holding trigger of one of the guns

notes.title: Bugfixes and adjustments
notes.content:
- Implemented StartupScreen that verifies connected VR headset and gives info in case the headset is not configured correctly
- Implemented different coloring for left and right weapons
- [Oculus] Implemented automatic game pause when bringing up the Oculus Menu
